Thanks for flagging it — if you see something similar again, you can raise it the same way.

One off-route segment was recorded, but it is exempt because an LTA-reported accident on the Tampines Expressway on the normal route came before the deviation, so the detour was justified. No voucher is issued for this case and no flag is placed on your account. Nothing further is needed from you.
